org: Global Insurance Accelerator (GIA), Des Moines, Iowa
description: World's first insurtech-focused accelerator, backed by Iowa's insurance industry (Iowa Economic Development / opportunityiowa.gov lists it under Finance & Insurance key industries). ~85 alumni companies claimed as of 2026 annual report.
coverage: PARTIAL - this is a genuine multi-year accelerator (cohorts every year since 2014), but the official companies page (globalinsuranceaccelerator.com/companies) is a JS-rendered Squarespace filter widget that would not yield company names to either WebFetch or raw-HTML grep (only cohort-year tag labels like "(2015)" were extractable, not the company names attached to each tag - the association is done client-side in JS we could not execute). Company names below are stitched together from press coverage found via WebSearch, not from the portfolio page itself.
honesty_note: Do not treat the empty cohort_years list as 'no companies' - it means the roster could not be pulled in this pass, not that GIA had no cohort that year. A future pass should try each /demo-day-YYYY page individually via WebFetch/curl rather than the aggregate /companies page.
